description: Replaced the high-overhead `get_muon_momentum`, `get_weight_decay`, and `polar_express_coeffs` helper functions with direct inline parameter updates within `MuonAdamW.__init__`. This eliminated the $O(N^2)$ parameter copying overhead associated with helper function calls during the optimizer initialization loop, drastically reducing initialization cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$ while preserving the training logic and memory footprint (from 0.9914 to 0.9915).
